subject: executor: fix outer join bug in hash join v2 (#56855)
summary: Fixes an incorrect probe-column offset when constructing results after `OtherCondition` in HashJoinV2 outer joins with inner-side build (notably right outer join when left side builds). The old offset used `currentChunk.NumCols()` (probe width) but the joined temporary chunk is laid out as `[left cols][right cols]`, so the correct boundary is `hashTableMeta.totalColumnNumber` (left/build width in that case). Adds regression tests (unit + jointest) covering mismatched left/right column counts and Issue 56825; upstream/master still retains this fix unchanged.
